items.title: 執行長表示，Replit 將 OpenAI 設為預設值，取代 Anthropic / Replit makes OpenAI its default over Anthropic, CEO says

sources.title: 執行長表示，Replit 不再與 Anthropic 合作 / Replit is no longer working with Anthropic, CEO says
sources.title_zh: 執行長表示，Replit 不再與 Anthropic 合作
sources.title_en: Replit is no longer working with Anthropic, CEO says
sources.title_original: Replit is no longer working with Anthropic, CEO says
sources.summary: Over the weekend, Masad clarified that OpenAI would replace Anthropic as its default model provider. Claude will still be available to customers on the platform.
sources.summary_zh: 在週末期間，瑪薩德（Masad）澄清 OpenAI 將取代 Anthropic 成為其預設模型提供者。Claude 仍將繼續提供給平臺上的客戶使用。
